name: Key hook
summary: The pegboard by the apartment door with the shared stuff drawn on hooks (car keys, the good umbrella, the HDMI cable); whatever is out shows an empty hook with the borrower's face and how long it's been gone, tap a thing to take it or hang it back and it swings off or on, and ask for something that's out to queue for it next.
useWhen: whoever took the good umbrella please return it
where is the hdmi cable, movie night is in an hour
can we track who has the shared stuff
i need the bike lock tomorrow, who has it
dontUseWhen: lending or selling to strangers (use marketplace tools)
splitting what shared things cost (use split-purchase)

place.description: Where the board hangs, e.g. '412 Pine'

holder.description: Who has it now; empty if it's on the hook

since.description: How long it's been out, as said: 'since Tuesday'

said.description: What the holder said about it, in their words
